component.name: Linuxit PDF
component.summary: Read PDFs and prepare booklet, poster and multiple-page printing
Leia PDFs e prepare impressão em livreto, pôster e várias páginas por folha

description.p: Linuxit PDF continues Winux PDF with progressive text search, light and dark themes, presentation, selection and advanced PDF print layouts.
Linuxit PDF continua o Winux PDF com busca progressiva, temas claro e escuro, apresentação, seleção e preparação avançada de impressão.

Development milestone: colour, opacity and size of existing annotations; marking and applying redaction in a new copy; poster image of 3D annotations; own corpora of damaged and encrypted PDFs with safer recovery and clear-metadata support; column reading order for accessible text and OCR copies; delivery audit against the tested commit and release preflight. Full original equivalence remains unverified.

Development milestone: own acceptance cases for all 65 plans, XFA field reading and hybrid XFA filling, number, date and mask form formats, incremental multiple signatures, document timestamp and embedded DSS verification offline, synchronized-folder cloud workflow, main-thread garbage collection for GTK stability and media playback preroll. Full original equivalence remains unverified.

Development milestone: comment threads, passive attachment formats, stemming, editable combos, local signatures, calibrated measurements, layer visibility and offline WAV export. Full original equivalence remains unverified.
Local synchronized folder shortcuts and complete exclusive PDF copies.
Local password tools, accessible page text, offline signature integrity and extended copy edits.
